plan.notes: Requirements-only: the official catalog publishes degree requirements but no official semester-by-semester sequence for this program. Majors in Social/Behavioral Sciences may waive up to 6 credit hours of General Education in the SB distribution area. Three Engaged Learning Experiences courses required (one at the 300-level, one Boundary Crossing). Transcribed from the Northeastern Illinois University Academic Catalog 2026-2027 (current online catalog).

courses.choice_note: Fine Arts (FA): 6 credit hours; 2 courses from at least two of Art, CMT (Mass Media or Theatre), Music (includes Dance)
courses.title: General education Fine arts requirement block

courses.choice_note: Humanities (HU): 9 credit hours; 3 courses from at least two of CMT (Communication), English, Linguistics, Philosophy, Women's and Gender Studies, World Languages and Cultures (no more than two foreign language courses)
courses.title: General education Humanities requirement block

courses.choice_note: Behavioral/Social Sciences (SB): 9 credit hours; 3 courses from at least two areas of study (Psychology majors may waive up to 6 hours in this area)
courses.title: General education Social and behavioral sciences requirement block

courses.choice_note: Natural Sciences (NS and NSL): 9 credit hours; 3 courses from at least two of Biology, Chemistry, Earth Science, Environmental Science, Physics; one course must have a laboratory component
courses.title: General education Natural sciences requirement block

courses.choice_note: Math/Quantitative Reasoning (MA): 1 math course with intermediate Algebra as prerequisite, or on the General Education approved list (3 credit hours)
